WELCOME TO
MECHANICAL AND AEROSPACE ENGINEERING
The Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering at the University of Miami blends hands-on learning with cutting-edge research in areas such as flight systems, biomechanics, and clean energy. With degrees in mechanical, sports, and aerospace engineering, the department offers a dynamic environment for innovation and impact, including student teams that compete in rocketry and robotic mining.
